title: Returning Member Qualifying Dollars on Retro-Credited Summit Segments
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program treats the qualifying dollars of a retro-credited segment differently when the segment was flown soon after the membership's latest inactivity forfeiture.

### Clause

The returning-member treatment decides what the posting counts in place of the share qualifying dollars, which are the eligible fare multiplied by the qualifying share percent, rounded to the cent. It follows the calendar days from the date of the latest inactivity forfeiture entry on the membership to the segment's flight date, as the segment's retro credit entry records it.

- **0 to 90 days after that forfeiture:** the posting counts, in place of the share qualifying dollars, the greater of two amounts: the share qualifying dollars multiplied by 1.5 and rounded down to the whole dollar; and the share qualifying dollars plus a flat 500 USD.
- **More than 90 and up to 365 days after it:** the posting counts, in place of the share qualifying dollars, the share qualifying dollars plus a flat 250 USD, with no multiplying.
- **Any other segment,** including one flown before the forfeiture, one flown more than 365 days after it, and one on a membership with no inactivity forfeiture: the posting counts the share qualifying dollars unchanged, to the cent.

Only forfeitures on the ground of inactivity count.

### Worked figures (hypothetical share qualifying dollars)

| Share qualifying dollars (USD) | Days after the forfeiture | Multiplied by 1.5, rounded down | Plus 500 | Counted (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1200.40 | 45 | 1800 | 1700.40 | 1800 |
| 600.55 | 45 | 900 | 1100.55 | 1100.55 |
| 600.55 | 200 | not used | not used | 850.55 |
| 600.55 | 400 | not used | not used | 600.55 |

### Day boundaries

Day 90 still falls in the first span and day 91 in the second; day 365 still falls in the second span and day 366 in neither.
